nodes.description: Owned.owner: privileged owner address, set to msg.sender at deployment and reassigned in acceptOwnership.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address staged by transferOwnership and consumed in acceptOwnership.
TPSToken.symbol public string token symbol set to TPS in constructor.
TPSToken.name public string token name set to TRUSTPAY SHARE in constructor.
TPSToken.decimals public uint8 set to 0 in constructor.
TPSToken._totalSupply fixed supply constant (200000000 * 10**decimals) read by totalSupply().
TPSToken.balances mapping(address=>uint) holding token balances, read/written by transfer and transferFrom.
TPSToken.allowed nested mapping allowance matrix, written by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom.
Owned constructor: assigns msg.sender to owner.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner: stages newOwner for two-step transfer.
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, then moves owner to newOwner and zeroes newOwner.
TPSToken constructor: sets metadata, mints _totalSupply to owner and emits Transfer.
totalSupply() view: returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using SafeMath.sub.
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) view: returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): SafeMath sub/add on balances[msg.sender]/balances[to] and emits Transfer.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): decrements balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], increments balances[to], emits Transfer.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) view: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then invokes receiveApproval on caller-supplied contract.
payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: forwards an external ERC20 transfer to owner.
SafeMath.add(uint a, uint b) pure: c = a + b with overflow require(c >= a).
SafeMath.sub(uint a, uint b) pure: require(b <= a) then c = a - b.
SafeMath.mul(uint a, uint b) pure: c = a * b with overflow require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.div(uint a, uint b) pure: require(b > 0) then c = a / b.
msg.sender used as initial privileged owner in Owned constructor.
msg.sender compared to owner inside the onlyOwner modifier guard.
msg.sender compared to newOwner in acceptOwnership to claim ownership.
msg.sender indexed into balances in transfer as the debited account.

External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an attacker-controlled address.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to a caller-supplied contract address.

edges.reason: msg.sender is trusted as the initial owner inside the Owned constructor.

owner state variable read as the authorization reference in the onlyOwner guard.
_newOwner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership writes newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the pending newOwner.
newOwner state variable is the authorization reference checked in acceptOwnership.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).

totalSupply subtracts burns tracked in balances[address(0)].
